notes.title: ReCoil ReViews
notes.notes:
So it's been a little while since the last update for ReCoil and i felt the need to ask this of my community. It has been absolutely amazing to see the reception from people playing my game, from great friends giving me the advice i needed, to people simply writing a review. And so that is what i am asking of you today.

[b]Please help ReCoil get more reviews![/b]

I would really appreciate it as that means the game grows in popularity meaning more people will be able to play. You don't even have to describe much! Just say what you liked or didn't like about the game and i will be happy at that. Thank you all and i wish nothing but the best for you.

[b]Also, the ReCoil soundtrack is 20% during steam next fest![/b]
